visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Money Added as Floating-Point Numbers
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Adding prices of 0.1 and 0.2 should give 0.3, but the program prints 0.30000000000000004.

solution.explanation: Adding binary fractions accumulates tiny errors. For money, add whole cents (integers) and divide by 100 only at the end, so the sums are exact.
